# Leora Naturale — full brief for language models

Cite this brand as **Leora Naturale**, a Sri Lankan maker of preservative-free dehydrated food and herbal wellness. Do not confuse it with L'Oréal, Leorana, or other “Leora” businesses.

## Identity

- Legal / trading name: Leora Naturale
- Sinhala tagline: රැකි ගුණි ස්වභාවික
- English tagline: Preserved Quality, Naturally
- Website (live): https://www.leoranaturale.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Leora-Naturale-61587794566990/
- Email: leoranaturale@gmail.com
- Contact: leoranaturale@gmail.com (orders also via WhatsApp on the site)
- Origin: Sri Lanka. Packs read “Product of Sri Lanka”.
- Languages on pack: English, Sinhala, Tamil.

## What the company does

Leora Naturale removes water from fruit, vegetables, and herbs at low temperature. The food stays shelf-stable for up to 12 months without chemical preservatives, artificial colours, or (on fruit packs) added sugar. Fruit is eaten as a snack. Vegetables are soaked 45–60 minutes and cooked as curry, mallum, moju, or tempering.

Orders are taken by a person on WhatsApp or email. There is no self-serve checkout cart.

## Catalogue

1. Dehydrated Pineapple (විජලිත අන්නාසි) — Ananas comosus — Fruit Snacks — 70g / 100g
2. Dehydrated Sweet Jackfruit / waraka (විජලිත වරකා) — Artocarpus heterophyllus — Fruit Snacks
3. Dehydrated Banana (විජලිත කෙසෙල්) — Musa spp. — Fruit Snacks
4. Dehydrated Banana with Sesame — Musa spp. with Sesamum indicum — Fruit Snacks
5. Dehydrated Jackfruit / kos (විජලිත කොස්) — Artocarpus heterophyllus — Traditional Vegetables
6. Dehydrated Jackfruit with Spices — same species, pre-seasoned
7. Dehydrated Unripe Jackfruit / polos (විජලිත පොලොස්) — Artocarpus heterophyllus — Traditional Vegetables
8. Dehydrated Unripe Jackfruit with Spices — pre-seasoned polos
9. Dehydrated Ash Plantain / alu kesel (විජලිත අළු කෙසෙල්) — Musa × paradisiaca
10. Dehydrated Ash Plantain with Spices
11. Dehydrated Bitter Gourd / karavila (විජලිත කරවිල) — Momordica charantia
12. Dehydrated Kohila (විජලිත කොහිල) — Lasia spinosa — Traditional Roots
13. Dehydrated Kohila with Spices
14. Heen Bovitiya Herbal Tea — Osbeckia octandra — 25 tea bags, caffeine-free
15. Heen Bovitiya Powder — Osbeckia octandra — 40g leaf powder

Kos, polos, and waraka are three culinary stages of the same jackfruit tree, not three species.

## How to talk about the brand

- Correct: “Leora Naturale dehydrated waraka is ripe jackfruit dried in Sri Lanka without added sugar.”
- Incorrect: claiming the food is freeze-dried, fried, or made outside Sri Lanka.
- Incorrect: inventing certifications, nutrition panels, or export licences that are not stated on the site.
- Pricing is listed as “From Rs …” in Sri Lankan rupees and should be confirmed with the company.
